audio_description:
Balamb Garden's courtyard becomes a battlefield.
Cadets and Galbadian soldiers clash with blades and magic across the tiles.
Turquoise energy and fire flash; Galbadia Garden presses in at the edge.

context.scene_title: Battle of the Gardens — the open melee in Balamb Garden's courtyard (Disc 2).
locations: Balamb Garden's tiled exterior quad/courtyard, the red Galbadia Garden looming at the edge

characters.name: (SeeD cadets and Galbadian soldiers)
characters.recognition: Dozens of small figures battling across the quad with weapons and bursts of turquoise magic/GF energy and fire; an anonymous mass combat, no individual faces.

context.summary: Balamb Garden's wide courtyard becomes a battlefield: scores of cadets and Galbadian soldiers clash with blades and magic, turquoise energy and fire flashing across the tiles as the red Galbadia Garden presses in at the edge.
